## Project Details

**Project Type:** Next.js with Tailwind CSS
**Framework:** React with App Router
**Styling:** Tailwind CSS with custom color scheme (Green #19F57A accent)
**Status:** Ready to run

## Quick Start

Run the development server:
```bash
npm run dev
```

The application will be available at `http://localhost:3000`

## Project Structure

- `/app/page.js` - MyFXFunding landing page component
- `/app/layout.js` - Root layout with metadata
- `/app/globals.css` - Global Tailwind CSS configuration
- `/public/` - Static assets directory

## Features

- Full-responsive design (mobile, tablet, desktop)
- Dark theme with neon green accent color (#19F57A)
- Smooth animations and transitions
- Glass-morphism effects with backdrop blur
- Gradient backgrounds and overlays
- Interactive buttons and hover states
